entries.heading: Make the search work better
entries.body: Rofo began in San Francisco by helping smaller businesses reach commercial-space information that was often hard to find or costly to navigate.

entries.heading: Understand the location, not just the listing
entries.body: The work had expanded to the character of a business and a place: transportation, customers, peers, workspace and room to grow.

entries.heading: Know where to look
entries.body: Rofo helps businesses understand districts, compare locations and then find spaces that fit.
